description: This Java source file defines the class AndroidApplicationPackageRenameProcessor, which handles renaming of Android application package elements within an IDE, including updating manifest files and package references.

classes.name: AndroidApplicationPackageRenameProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes renaming of Android application packages, updating manifest files and package references accordingly.

methods.name: canProcessElement
methods.description: Determines if the element can be processed for renaming, specifically if it's a package or package attribute in manifest.

methods.name: renameElement
methods.description: Performs the renaming of the package element or XML attribute, updating all relevant references.

methods.name: computeNewQName
methods.description: Computes the new qualified name based on old and new package names.

methods.name: buildAttr2ClassMap
methods.description: Builds a map from XML attribute values to PsiClass objects within an XML file.

methods.name: processAllAttributesToUpdate
methods.description: Processes all class attribute values in an XML file to update package references.

methods.name: processAllClassAttrValues
methods.description: Recursively processes all class attribute values in an XML file.
